records.text: Events at which Erika Kirk was scheduled to speak have been canceled because of backlash.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep i8m_6D4QGmk)

appearances.snippet: Actually, I'll tell you that I have it on very good authority that they have had to cancel events that Erika Kirk was intended to speak at because there has been a backlash.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 66:19. The episode relies on an unnamed source. Later reporting documents one canceled Erika Kirk appearance attributed to security threats, not multiple canceled events caused by backlash; no reliable source verifies the claim as stated.
